description_en: Creates access configurations in batches for public assets that have not been accessed under the current account. When WithAutoAccess is set to true, automatic access is also enabled so that new assets are automatically accessed based on the configurations
description_zh: 为当前账号下尚未接入的公网资产批量创建接入配置。WithAutoAccess 取值为 true 时，同时开启自动接入，使后续新增资产按配置接入
name: CreateIdcTractionForAllAsset

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic access at the same time. If this parameter is set to true, access is enabled for current public assets and automatic access is enabled for all supported resource types. If this parameter is not specified or is set to false, access is enabled only for current public assets
parameters.help_zh: 是否同时开启自动接入。取值为 true 时，为当前公网资产开启接入，并启用全部受支持资源类型的自动接入；不传或取值为 false 时，仅为当前公网资产开启接入
parameters.name: with_auto_access

FailedAssetDetail.description_en: The details of assets that failed to be processed

AssetId.description_en: The ID of the public assets

AssociatedInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the cloud resource instance associated with the public IP address
AssociatedInstanceId.description_zh: 公网 IP 关联的云资源实例 ID

AssociatedInstanceName.description_en: The name of the cloud resource instance associated with the public IP address
AssociatedInstanceName.description_zh: 公网 IP 关联的云资源实例名称

Reason.description_en: The failure reason code, such as NotFoundAsset, ExceedQuota, AgentNotFound, TractionInstanceQuotaExceeded, or TractionFailed
Reason.description_zh: 失败原因代码，例如 NotFoundAsset、ExceedQuota、AgentNotFound、TractionInstanceQuotaExceeded 或 TractionFailed

FailedCount.description_en: The number of assets that failed to be processed

Status.description_en: The accessed state for full access. This parameter is returned only when WithAutoAccess is set to true. ACCESSED indicates that the current assets have been accessed. SYNCING indicates that synchronization is in progress and new assets are being accessed
Status.description_zh: 全量接入状态。仅 WithAutoAccess 取值为 true 时返回：ACCESSED 表示当前资产已完成接入，SYNCING 表示正在同步并接入新增资产

SucceedCount.description_en: The number of assets that were successfully processed

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code. This parameter is empty if the request is successful
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码。请求成功时为空

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
